drivers: Three independent attributes (count, shape/fill bundle, rotation) must be tracked, but each follows a simple progression
Count 3→4→5 and rotation 45→90→135 are transparent sequences in the third row itself
Distractors with count 1 and triangle shape exploit wrap-around/column confusions; rotation differences of 45° require careful visual check
Fill is constant across options so it offers no help, forcing shape and angle discrimination
